## v1.0.0

3D-printable cases for the Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.8: a deep back plate that holds a
real battery, and a desk stand.

### Back plate

One file per battery. Print one, plus the optional hole plugs.

| Battery | File |
|---|---|
| 103035, 1000 mAh, on its edge (recommended) | `back_plate_103035_1000mAh_edge.stl` |
| 802525, 400 mAh, flat | `back_plate_802525_400mAh_flat.stl` |
| 104050, 2400 mAh, on its end (tight, measure first) | `back_plate_104050_2400mAh_end.stl` |
| Hole plugs, optional (not for babies) | `amoled18_hole_plugs.stl` |

Screws: 4 × M2 × 4 socket head.

### Desk stand

One head, plus the box for your battery.

| Part | File |
|---|---|
| Head, with a 3 mm collar | `amoled18_stand_head.stl` |
| Head, without the collar (alternative) | `amoled18_stand_head_no_collar.stl` |
| Box for the 103035 (recommended) | `amoled18_stand_box_103035_edge.stl` |
| Box for the 802525 | `amoled18_stand_box_802525_flat.stl` |
| Box for the 104050 (tight, measure first) | `amoled18_stand_box_104050_end.stl` |

The collar shows as a band between the box and the display, so print the head in a different
colour for each unit to tell them apart.

Screws: 4 × M2 × 5 socket head to hold the display on the head (M2 × 4 for the head without the
collar), and 6 × M2 × 8 countersunk to hold the head in the box.

How to print and put it together: [PRINTING.md](https://github.com/jeffmhopkins/esp32-s3-touch-amoled-1.8-case/blob/v1.0.0/PRINTING.md)
